text:
maria_support: ACME SRE: seeing p99 spikes (~800ms-1.2s) for eu-west-1 models since 09:22UTC. Customer trace shows a hop to us-west-2. Repro attached.

devon_oncall: Can you paste the trace + the exact curl you used? Any request ids?

maria_support: paste: 
ACME trace id: trace-7c9e
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' -s https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -D -

Trace snippet:
client -> lb eu-west-1 -> edge-eu -> 52.30.12.45 -> 34.223.11.7 (us-west-2) -> model-eu (via peering) : 820ms

acme_sre (via DM): We see it consistently around 09:22 and again at 09:27

alex_neteng: Hmm that hop to 34.223.11.7 looks like our us-west transit. Can you run traceroute from the edge-eu host and paste?

maria_support: tracebot ran traceroute attached:
```
traceroute to model-eu (52.30.12.45), 10 hops max
 1 10.0.0.1 0.5 ms
 2 10.1.0.1 1.2 ms
 3 edge-eu.redwood 2.1 ms
 4 transit-peer-1 10.9 ms
 5 34.223.11.7 (us-west-2) 700 ms
 6 model-eu 702 ms
```

priya_infra: Checking routing policy: I see a fallback rule 'region_fallback: global' with threshold 95% full. eu-west-1 peaked at 96% at 09:20UTC -> triggered global fallback to us-west-2. That explains the hop.

devon_oncall: Oof. That threshold was lowered in the canary on Tuesday to 95 for burst handling. Looks like it was too aggressive for ACME's traffic profile.

alex_neteng: Short-term mitigation: send customer a header to pin region `X-Region-Pin: eu-west-1` which bypasses fallback, or increase eu capacity. Long-term: adjust fallback heuristics and add sticky routing based on client-origin.

maria_support: ACME agreed to try region pin header. Repro after header shows p50 ~40ms, p99 120ms. Confirmed.

priya_infra: I'll open infra ticket to rollback the 95% fallback threshold and add a gradual ramp and better metric alerts. Ticket INFRA-3129.

devon_oncall: Also will add a temporary rule to exclude premium customers from global fallback.

maria_support: Adding notes to ACME case and tagging infra/sre. Thanks all :pray: :eyes:
